passage: While the allocation of caste-based reservations is often based on population shares of these disadvantaged castes, female reservation is effectively random (Chattopadhyay and Duflo, 2004; Pathak and Macours, 2017).

claims.reading: Narrower analytic reading. Both papers use rule-based assignment as a research design in the settings they study. Each invokes conditions under which the rule may be treated as random.

Broader reading in context. Does the cited evidence establish as-if-random assignment across the districts and villages in Brown et al.’s sample? Brown et al. give their own balance check in the next sentence; this judgment concerns what the two references establish.

passage: Female leaders in village Panchayats also improve the quality and effectiveness of rural development programs, including the National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS) (Beaman et al., 2012; Deininger et al., 2015), and are better at providing local jobs under the NREGS as an insurance against negative shocks (Bose and Das, 2018; Deininger et al., 2020).

claims.scope: are better at providing local jobs under the NREGS
claims.reading: Narrower analytic reading. Does research find more program employment received under reserved leadership? Actual work received can rise through demand, supply, or both. It does not identify a leader’s job allocation decisions by itself.

claims.scope: are better at providing local jobs under the NREGS as an insurance against negative shocks
claims.reading: Full clause, read as a claim of better protection during shocks. Evidence would compare the response to an adverse shock across leadership conditions. If the last words only describe the purpose of NREGS, the narrower reading applies.

claims.reading: Does focus mean policy priorities, direct investments, or improved outcomes for girls? The sentence also leaves open which example belongs to which source. If these are complementary illustrations, each paper could contribute something different.

claims.reading: These two studies investigate how the gender of the council head relates to local public goods. The surrounding references concern different subjects. Das does not claim the estimated effects have the same sign.

claims.reading: The preceding text describes reserving village council seats and presidencies for women and disadvantaged castes. As a pointer to institutional details, each source can cover a different part of that description.
